name: bringback5hourlimit
description: Bring back the 5-hour usage limit as a local, self-imposed rolling cap for Claude Code (works on verified Ultra, Max, Pro, and offline).

windowHours.title: Block length (hours)
windowHours.description: Length of one rolling block. 5 recreates the old 5-hour limit. Env: BB5H_WINDOW_HOURS.

mode.title: Measuring strategy
mode.description: auto picks the best available: Anthropic's 5-hour %, else weekly-% delta, else local token count. official, weekly or tokens forces one. Env: BB5H_MODE.

officialCapPct.title: Cap on Anthropic's 5-hour % (official)
officialCapPct.description: Block new work when Anthropic's own 5-hour window reaches this %. Env: BB5H_OFFICIAL_CAP_PCT.

weeklyBudgetPct.title: Block budget, % of weekly (weekly)
weeklyBudgetPct.description: How much of the weekly limit one block may spend. 15 is about 6-7 full blocks a week; not Anthropic's old ratio. Env: BB5H_BLOCK_BUDGET_PCT_OF_WEEKLY.

tokenBudget.title: Block budget, tokens (tokens)
tokenBudget.description: Weighted tokens per block (input + output + cache writes + 10% of cache reads), summed over all sessions. Env: BB5H_TOKEN_BUDGET.

warnPct.title: Warn at (% of block budget)
warnPct.description: Show a warning at this share of the budget. Env: BB5H_WARN_PCT.

failMode.title: When usage can't be measured
failMode.description: open allows work and shows a warning; closed refuses new work. Env: BB5H_FAIL_MODE.

showBar.title: Live bar above the prompt
showBar.description: Show the live usage bar. /5h bar toggles it. Env: BB5H_SHOW_BAR.

barPosition.title: Bar position
barPosition.description: above: its own band above the input (default). below: at the end of the hint line under the input (takes no extra row). /5h bar above|below switches. Env: BB5H_BAR_POSITION.

timeZone.title: Time zone for reset times
timeZone.description: IANA zone like Asia/Kolkata or America/New_York. Empty uses the system zone. Env: BB5H_TIMEZONE.
